proposition.claim:
Pairwise l-infinity separation of arbitrary plaquette sets supplies one coordinate globally separating the entire sets.

L=3. P1 consists of yz-unit plaquettes at x1=-3,+3, x4=0. P2 consists of the corresponding plaquette at x1=0. ambient cubic lattice contains all vertices.
